baseline_entropy: 1 unjustified plan change after acceptance had already been achieved
2 speculative plan changes without root-cause diagnosis
task_results.spari_behavior: root-cause diagnosis followed by targeted correction

productive_recomposition.definition: Evidence-driven strategy change that directly responds to newly observed failure or diagnostic evidence.

unjustified_plan_change.definition: Speculative or arbitrary strategy change without materially new evidence.

abandoned_implementation.definition: Functional or executable work superseded through avoidable branching without retained reusable value.

coding_rules.double_counting_policy: Each physical execution event contributes at most one EEI point unless separate independently observable events occurred.

bounded_conclusion: In the audited Claude Code recovery tasks, SPARI v0.1.3 reduced measured unproductive recovery execution entropy from 4 EEI events to 0 while preserving 100% verified task completion. The effect resulted from replacing speculative recovery changes with diagnostic, evidence-driven recomposition.
scope_limitations: 100% reduction applies only to the two bounded recovery tasks
No claim that SPARI eliminates all agent entropy
No claim that SPARI eliminates uncertainty or necessary exploration
No generalization beyond the tested Claude Code setup
No new runs were conducted during cleanup
